# VoltChina

> VoltChina provides source-verified Chinese-language intelligence for focused questions about China's EV, battery, smart-driving, robotics, supplier, and manufacturing claims.

## Core pages

- [VoltChina home](https://voltchina.net/): Overview of VoltChina's public research, free brief, and written research service.
- [VoltChina Intelligence](https://voltchina.net/intelligence): Submit a focused pre-diligence or strategy research question. VoltChina replies in writing with suitability, scope, fixed price, exclusions, and delivery date.
- [Robotics Access Pilot](https://voltchina.net/robotics): Written product matching, project requirement coordination, manufacturer quotation requests, and introductions for qualified robotics research and integration teams.
- [Sourcing Pilot](https://voltchina.net/sourcing): Legacy buyer-side Chinese supplier screening and written RFQ coordination page retained for existing links.
- [Research and Editorial Analysis](https://voltchina.net/research): Public research samples and clearly labelled editorial analysis.

## Public research sample

- [BYD All-Solid-State Battery Commercialization Timeline](https://voltchina.net/research/byd-solid-state-battery-2026): A public-source assessment of reported around-2027 demonstration and around-2030 mass-production milestones. Includes a linked 11-page evidence report.

## Scope and standards

VoltChina separates confirmed public facts, company claims, reasonable inference, and evidence gaps. It does not provide investment, legal, or procurement advice, and does not guarantee transaction, delivery, or supplier outcomes.
